prompt_used:
Transform the entire figure into a contemporary polished gold sculpture — mirror-bright warm yellow gold with a high specular finish, the surface smooth and flowing with no visible tool marks. hair is poured liguid gold that matches the subjects with deep carved separations catching bright highlights. No human skin anywhere — the face is polished gold like the rest. Framed from mid-chest to the top of the head, both shoulders and upper arms fully rendered. The figure faces us naturally, head upright, with both eyes clearly visible. The subject's own garment carries through in the same material.  Flattering soft key light, shadow separating jaw from neck. the background is an expensively appointed conservatory with many windows with warm lighting streaming through inside potted trees and plants. Make the creation match age.
Mainting subjects hair style, hairline, face shape. micro gestures.
No held objects — no cups, glasses, phones, books, tools, watches or eyewear. Worn jewellery is fine: necklaces, earrings, piercings.
The likeness is essential. Maintain micro facial gestures, imperfections, changes in symmetry. all the characteristics that make this person this person. The hair should be organically faithful in messy or organized condition.
